verdict.rationale: RudderStack docs explicitly cite Live Events (near real-time source/destination event viewing), a Health Dashboard for pipeline metrics, Alerts for critical data issues, and MCP-powered destination delivery error investigation with root-cause analysis. These directly map to debugger views, delivery metrics, and alerting. Missing for 10: no independent/hands-on validation of the debugger UI itself or alerting reliability, and no detail on granularity of per-destination delivery metrics beyond marketing bullet points.
